sentences.text: For floating-rate loans granted for business purpose to Micro and Small Enterprises, the relevant limit is in paragraph 261(2)(ii) of the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025.
That paragraph says a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh.
The same directions state that paragraph 261 applies to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026.
I could not confirm applicability to this specific loan because the sanction date was not provided.

missing.searched: Checked the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 paragraph 261 applicability rule and the rule findings; no sanction date was provided.
